text:
𝟮𝟬𝟬𝟳 𝗧𝟮𝟬 𝗪𝗢𝗥𝗟𝗗 𝗖𝗨𝗣 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗠𝗣𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦 🏆

India beat Pakistan by 5 runs in the first T20 World Cup final, Johannesburg.
India 157/5, Pakistan 152 all out. Gambhir made 75 and MS Dhoni led the way. 🇮🇳

#Cricket #T20WorldCup
